remarks: Located on splendid Delaware Avenue, this 2 Bedroom 6th floor condo is ready to move into. The open floor plan includes an updated gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances, wood cabinetry and granite counter tops, and a breakfast bar. Open to the living area and dining areas, the northern views are wonderful. There are hardwood floors throughout the living areas and recessed lighting. The 2 good sized bedrooms have western exposure and ample closet space. One could be a great home office. The full bath boasts a large walk-in tiled shower with a granite vanity top. The roof top deck is beyond compare and open only to residents. There is a sought after attached garage and Central Air conditioning. Garage space 27, pet friendly. The HOA includes all utilities except cable. sqft per appraisal or professional measurement
